query:

In the first year when both models were sold at the same time, sales of the early models exceeded those of the new models, and the manufacturer concluded that safety was not the customer's top priority.

The statement that 'the new type of engine can be used by all aircraft using the old type of engine' most seriously weakens the manufacturer's conclusion.
predicted_answer: The new type of engine can be used by all aircraft using the old type of engine
